description: Evidence-backed pre-conversion sales methodology and LiNKclient handoff preparation without execution authority.

routing.when_to_use: Use for evidenced pre-conversion lead qualification, deterministic priority, pipeline or proposal preparation, conversion readiness, LiNKclient handoff, or founder escalation.
when_not_to_use: Do not use as an Odoo connector or CRM runtime.
Do not use to send messages, mutate records, commit pricing, or promise renewals.
Do not use with live credentials, customer data, contract text, or private company data.
exclusion_rules: LiNKclient owns onboarding and the customer lifecycle after evidenced conversion.
The owning consumer owns Odoo credentials and connector execution.

required_inputs.name: request
required_inputs.description: Synthetic request reference, workflow, source evidence, authority, and privacy classification.

expected_outputs.name: result
expected_outputs.description: Auditable preparation, denial, or escalation with no live effects.

execution.procedure_summary: Normalize evidence, reason over authority and risk, prepare an owner-bound artifact, and append redacted audit state.
forbidden_actions: Store or echo live credentials, customer data, contract text, or private company data
Send messages or commit pricing, contracts, or renewals
verification_steps: Confirm no prohibited paths or live effects
completion_criteria: Output contract is complete and evidence-grounded
Owner, escalation, and rollback are explicit

telemetry.retention_policy: retain synthetic IDs, evidence hashes, and receipts only
